algorithm.title: Algorithm for the Evaluation of Suspected Hyperparathyroidism

cell.label: Hypercalcemia (corrected for serum albumin: serum Calcium - [(4.0 - serum albumin) * 0.8] )
Any secondary cause (thiazides, lithium, excess calcium intake, evidence of chronic kidney disease, etc. ) ?
Stop offending agent and retest in 2 to 3 weeks
Not PHPT, consider: malignancy milk-alkali syndrome chronic kidney disease vitamin D excess
Measure 24-hour urine calcium and creatinine excretion
Familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia (PTH can be normal)

Less than 50 years old? Symptomatic? Serum Ca > 1.0 mg/dL above normal limit? Urinary Ca excretion > 400 mg/day? Evidence of osteoporosis? 30% decrease in renal function? Unable to follow-up appropriately?
Parathyroidectomy if no contraindications to surgery.
